subject: Scheduling technical deep dive — infra & ops alignment
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cameron Reeves <cameron@novalabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery recap + next step: 60–90m infra + ops deep dive

Hi Cameron —

Thanks again for the thoughtful conversation this morning. Quick recap (so we’re aligned):
- Goal: validate performance & cost profile for your inference workload and map changes to infra/ops ownership.
- Primary constraints: 1) strict data residency for EU PII, 2) sustained burst traffic pattern (500–1k reqs/min), 3) 99th percentile latency target ~150ms for gen flows.

Next recommended step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML infra engineers and ops leads to walk through architecture, sample traffic, and the mutual action plan. We’ll cover:
- Inference runtime choices & quantization impact
- Autoscaling and burst handling (Dedicated vs hosted routing)
- Caching/batching guidance for your prompt distribution
- Rollout/rollback and tracing integrations

Proposed windows (Pacific):
- Tue 22 Dec, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 23 Dec, 15:00–16:30

Please confirm which window works (or suggest two alternatives) and share the Novalabs attendees you’d like in the room (ML lead, infra lead, security contact). I’ve attached the call notes and a short agenda template to speed the prep.

Attachments: novalabs-postdiscovery-notes.pdf (summary), tdx-agenda-template.md (editable)

If those two windows don’t work, happy to open a couple morning slots the week of Jan 4.

Thanks — looking forward to getting ops and infra aligned.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

Redwood Inference — inference made predictable

From: Cameron Reeves <cameron@novalabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Riya Shah <riya.shah@novalabs.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap + next step: 60–90m infra + ops deep dive

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear recap. Both Riya and I reviewed internally and we definitely want the 60–90m deep dive to include our infra and security leads. Our infra lead (ops@novalabs.com) is out Tuesday morning, so your Tue slot won’t work. Wed 23 Dec 15:00–16:30 PT is doable for us.

Attendees from Novalabs:
- Cameron Reeves (product lead) — cameron@novalabs.com
- Riya Shah (platform infra) — riya.shah@novalabs.com
- Anu Patel (security/compliance) — anu.patel@novalabs.com (cc’d on invite I’ll send once we lock time)

Two quick asks to include in the agenda:
1) brief checklist of required artifacts for a security review (SOC 2 evidence, KMS flow)
2) a slide showing latency/cost tradeoffs for quantized variants vs fp16 in a sustained-burst scenario — that will help our CTO decide.

I’ll send a calendar invite to Wed 23rd 15:00 PT if you confirm you can hold that time.

Onwards —
Cameron

Grace (cc) from our ML infra team will lead the technical walkthrough; Priyom will cover ops/runbook questions and rollout patterns. Draft agenda below — feel free to edit before I attach to the invite:

Draft agenda (60–90m):
- 0–10m: intros & goals (Marcus)
- 10–30m: workload profile + observed constraints (Cameron + Novalabs)
- 30–60m: runtime & infra options (Grace) — quantization, batching, autoscale paths
- 60–75m: security/compliance checklist & evidence path (Priyom)
- 75–90m: mutual action plan & next steps (all)

Prep items for Novalabs (please share before the call if possible):
- representative payloads + 1k sample prompts
- P95/P99 latency targets per endpoint
- any existing inference logs or traces (zip)

I’ll draft a mutual action plan after the call and add the HubSpot deal link to keep actions tracked. I’ve also attached the agenda template for edits.

If that agenda looks good I’ll accept your invite and add Grace/Priyom to the calendar.

— Marcus
